subject: soc-rt
title: SOC.RT.------PROG.CONT.
description: Diagram in AF(D)-32, on the page where Braxton argues that 'the dissolution of the composite-affinity-alignment aspect of source transfer can also be viewed with respect to the political developments which have taken place in the progressional rise and fall of world culture groups' — and that the 'manipulation of affinity dynamics is not separate from manipulation on the physical universe level.' SOC-RT (social reality) is crossed with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance): the question is what social reality requires of progressional continuance when the manipulation apparatus is operative. (R)RE-DIF (the reality of redefinitions) and SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) branch from the main line. CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics) also branches from the main line and carries two chains: INFO-RT (information reality), which carries MT-INFO-DB (multi-informational degree basis) and LK-IMP (linkage implications), and S-ST (source shift (progressionalism) manipulation), which leads to PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance). Structural argument: social reality crossed with progressional continuance flows through the source-shift / culture-information-dynamics layer. The diagram thus exposes how affinity isolation works at the structural level: by routing social reality through a manipulation-layered chain into projectional continuance.
